# Lab6

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/Jonatanprepuk/Lab6/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Jonatanprepuk/Lab6/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
<!-- badges: end -->

This package implements three different algorithms to the [napsack problem](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Knapsack_problem). 


## Installation

You can install the development version of Lab6 from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` {r, eval=FALSE}
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("Jonatanprepuk/Lab6")
```

## Example
### Create data 
```{r example}
library(Lab6)

suppressWarnings(RNGversion(min(as.character(getRversion()), "3.5.3")))
set.seed(42, kind = "Mersenne-Twister", normal.kind = "Inversion")
n <- 1000000
knapsack_objects <- data.frame(
  w = sample(1:4000, size = n, replace = TRUE),
  v = runif(n = n, 0, 10000)
)
```

### Brute force
```{r}
brute_force_knapsack(knapsack_objects[1:16, ], W = 3500)
```

### Dynamic 
```{r}
knapsack_dynamic(knapsack_objects[1:500, ], W = 5000)
```

### Greedy
```{r}
# Runs R implementation
greedy_knapsack(knapsack_objects[1:1000000, ], W = 5000)

# Runs Rcpp implementation
greedy_knapsack(knapsack_objects[1:1000000, ], W = 5000, fast = TRUE)
```
